name: Southfury Watershed
summary: The Southfury Watershed is the rugged western drainage basin of central Durotar, nestled against the winding Southfury River. Though typically dry and scorched like the surrounding canyonlands, this frontier provides a critical border buffer between the settlement of Razor Hill and the hostile quilboar strongholds of the Barrens.

sections.title: A Contested Frontier
sections.body: Spanning the arid slopes between Razor Hill and the Southfury River, the Southfury Watershed is defined by harsh, sun-baked earth cut by natural drainage runoffs. Bordered by Thunder Ridge to the north and the sprawling encampments of the Razormane tribe to the south, the basin is an unforgiving landscape roamed by native raptors, scorpids, and aggressive quilboar scouts. Guarding this western approach is essential for the defense of central Durotar, as it lies directly along the migratory trails and skirmish lines running between orc settlements and the wild expanse across the river.

sections.title: Wilds Beyond the Watchtowers
sections.body: Because Durotar is an arid land with scarce freshwater, any terrain sloping toward the Southfury River holds tactical and survival value. Despite its proximity to civilization, the Watershed remains untamed. Orc patrols stationed out of Razor Hill keep a constant vigil over the basin, watchful for quilboar incursions pushing up from the Razormane Grounds and river predators creeping into the dry washes.

faq.q: Where is the Southfury Watershed located?
faq.answer: The Watershed sits in western central Durotar. It is framed by Razor Hill to the east, the Southfury River to the west, Thunder Ridge and Tor'kren Farm to the north, and the Razormane Grounds to the south.
The basin is inhabited by predatory beasts including scorpids, raptors, and river crocolisks, alongside scouting warbands of hostile Razormane quilboar moving north from their nearby camps.

faq.q: Why is this area important to the Horde?
aliases: why does horde care about watershed
faq.answer: The watershed connects the heart of Durotar to the Southfury River and the Barrens beyond. Securing it protects Razor Hill from quilboar raids and ensures Horde couriers can travel the western trails without being ambushed.

faq.q: Can you cross into the Barrens from here?
faq.answer: Yes. Heading directly west down the watershed brings travelers to the banks of the Southfury River, where a swimmer or careful wader can cross the border into the wild savannah of the Barrens.

angles.text: The watershed serves as the western flank for Razor Hill; securing its ravines against aggressive quilboar keeps the heart of Durotar safe from surprise border attacks.
The arid hollows and river runoffs are prowled by fierce native crocolisks, scorpids, and raptors, making the watershed an ideal proving ground for young hunters mastering their tracking.
